page.content:
Sweden hosts; a seventeen-year-old Pelé announces Brazil.

How 1958 FIFA World Cup connects

  • Character: Pelé — Pelé won the 1958 World Cup in Sweden at seventeen.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — The 1958 tournament is Pelé's first World Cup chapter.

What is 1958 FIFA World Cup?

The 1958 World Cup in Sweden was Brazil's first title. Pelé scored in the final against the hosts and became the tournament's lasting face.
